GAME UPDATE:

Crash-land on Critteria and embark on a cozy, out-of-this-world adventure! In Cosmic Coop, you’ll transform a patch of alien soil into a bustling farm brimming with adorable Critterlings—each with its own quirks and cosmic charms.

Decorate & Attract
Channel your inner designer and fill your farm with shimmering altars, glowing lights, and lush crops. Every new decoration tempts curious Critterlings to stop by—and maybe even stick around for good!

Build & Nurture
From constructing snug coops to planting local flora, turn your farm into a vibrant haven. Each discovery, whether it’s a rare seed or a newly hatched Critterling, brings you closer to beauty of Critteria.

Explore & Befriend
It’s not just Critterlings who call this planet home. Encounter strange anthropomorphic neighbors who offer advice, trade essential items, and share stories about the world you’ve stumbled upon. Friendship, after all, is the greatest resource in the galaxy.

Features

  • Embark on a Journey: Uncover around 30 unique Critterlings.

  • Craft Harmonious Ecosystems: Strategically design your farm to ensure harmonious living among the Critterlings, avoiding potential conflicts.

  • Defend and Protect: Guard your haven against unpredictable cosmic invaders.

  • Help the locals: Take on quests and solve all the troubles the villagers might face.

  • Crafting Galore: Source materials and innovate with crafting, enhancing your farm with new creations.

  • Engage in Cosmic Chatter: Share whimsical dialogues with the planet's native anamorphic inhabitants.

Inspiration

While creature-collecting is often associated with the Pokémon series, Cosmic Coop actually draws its inspiration from titles like Viva Piñata and Neko Atsume. The creature collection element is very similar to how you meet new creatures in those titles. Cosmic Coop is also inspired by classic farming games such as Harvest Moon, Stardew Valley, and even inspiration from Forager. If you're a fan of any of these games, then Cosmic Coop is sure to resonate with you!

short_description: "Cosmic Coop" is an alien farming/creature collector odyssey! Lure adorable Critterlings with captivating objects, build thriving ecosystems, and fend off cosmic threats. Craft for your farm and connect with eccentric natives. It’s more than farming—it’s cosmic companionship!
